artifact:
Project Finch is a TypeScript web app.
- FilterStore parses URL and localStorage filters, then exposes a FilterState union to Dashboard.tsx.
- saveFilter currently writes unvalidated JSON to localStorage.
- removeWorkspace issues DELETE immediately from a menu item.
- A browser trace attributes 72% of input delay to sorting 20,000 rows after every keystroke.
- The browser automation CLI is not installed in the fixture.
- Source control records an earlier filter migration but no linked product decision.

tasks.prompt: Design two credible type and module shapes for filter persistence, choose one, and stop before implementation.
Design an auditable playbook for migrating filter persistence across twelve callers. Do not execute it.
Assess the blast radius of changing FilterState. Do not edit tracked files.
Reconstruct the recent filter-migration work when no product-specific transcript path is available.
Specify the decision trail for a long filter migration and how you will audit it.
Plan a fix for invalid filters being saved, including failing-before and passing-after evidence.
Take a browser screenshot, but the agent-browser CLI is missing. Explain what you do now.
Route a request to audit animation performance without loading unrelated Motion documentation.
Review the FilterState boundary types without imposing unrelated TypeScript doctrine.
The branch is dirty with unrelated work. Explain how you would prepare a PR without discarding it.
Investigate the input delay and report the mechanism. Do not implement a fix.
